# HTML Blocks Read As Markdown

<div>
A tag in a code span is code: `<span>`.
A tag after a backslash is text: \<em>, while <b>this</b> is HTML.
</div>

> <details>
> `<summary>` in a quote is code, and <summary>this</summary> is HTML.
> </details>

<pre>
```html
<i>A tag in a fenced code block is code.</i>
```
</pre>
